items.question: How will the true nature of the outcaste woman be declared to the goddess?
premises: The speaker addresses the goddess directly.
The speaker promises to declare something about the outcaste woman.
The declaration is to be made as things truly are.
items.inference: The speaker will truthfully expound the nature of the outcaste woman to the goddess.
uncertainties: The specific doctrinal content about the outcaste woman is not stated in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: O goddess, listen: I shall declare the outcaste woman as she truly is.
